Name: Velvet house - Riftworks addon
Author: Alex3108
Description:
[size=4][b]This add-on adds a brothel to Riftworks buildings. Accept clients, assign your bond cards, upgrade rooms, and hire staff to satisfy your customers' needs. [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Velvet House is an optional content pack for [b]Valley Bonds: Riftworks[/b]. It adds a new hospitality-focused building with themed rooms, visitors, staff, reputation, upgrades, and daily management. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Valley Bonds, Isekai Bonds, and Riftworks. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the
[/color]
[code]ValleyBonds.Riftworks.Brothel[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into your Stardew Valley
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Build the Velvet House from the Riftworks settlement menu. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Do not place the ZIP file directly inside the
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]New optional Riftworks building. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiple themed room types. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Visitor preferences and room matching. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Staff and Bond Card assignments. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Reputation, income, upgrades, and daily reports. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Guest Bell campaign support. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]English and Russian localization. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mature themes without explicit visual content.
[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or later. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Riftworks. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]This add-on does not work as a standalone mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley and SMAPI communities, Riftworks testers, and everyone who provided feedback on rooms, guests, balancing, and hospitality gameplay. [/color][/*]
